description: Data table titled 'Sealed Indictments: 10/30/17 through 6/30/18', credited to a named research team of Twitter handles. It lists every U.S. federal district court by state with monthly counts of new sealed court proceedings filed in eight periods from 10/30/17 to 6/30/18, with monthly totals and a highlighted grand total of 40,483 (5,060 per month average). Footnotes cite PACER.gov as the source, give tinyurl backup links, claim 1,077 sealed cases in all of 2006 per a 2009 report, and note the counts include criminal charges and search warrants, some since unsealed or removed.
text: Sealed Indictments: 10/30/17 through 6/30/18. From the research team of: @Arazel50, @Avery1776, @Avonsalez, @buildthewall_20, @damartin32, @emarie1225, @KathyMicale, @LemboPhil, @MScipio_African, @t193931, @TanHaley, @Tspinnerchaser & @vstil. State, District. Abbrev. 10/30-11/22. 11/27 - 12/22. 12/26-1/26. 1/29-2/28. 3/1-3/31. 4/1-4/30. 5/1-5/31. 6/1-6/30. [Table of all U.S. federal districts, Alaska through Wyoming plus DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, Virgin Islands and Northern Mariana Islands, with per-period counts; Georgia Northern row reads 'No Data Available'.] Totals: 4,188. 5,106. 4,311. 4,905. 6,034. 5,326. 5,318. 5,295. Total filed from 10/30/17 to 6/30/18 = 40,483 (5,060 per month average). * Back-up files at: https://tinyurl.com/yd5vn9ou. * Source: PACER.gov. * How many are normal? 1,077 in all of 2006 per 2009 report: https://tinyurl.com/y97q9w4g. * The numbers represent new sealed court proceedings filed in U.S. Federal District Criminal Courts during the periods listed and include criminal charges and search warrants. Some of them have since been unsealed or removed.
flags: The 'sealed indictments' interpretation of these PACER filings is a community claim; analyses have noted the counts include routine sealed proceedings (warrants, wiretaps), not indictments per se
FLAGGED FOR MANUAL REVIEW: table body contains ~750 per-district numeric cells; only headers, totals row and footnotes transcribed verbatim

description: Ben Garrison political cartoon titled 'A House Divided...', drawn in the style of an M.C. Escher impossible-staircase print (credited 'Apologies to MC Escher'). Interlocking staircases carry caricatured factions shouting slogans: a Republican elephant and Democrat donkey, an MSM rat saying 'Never Trump!', figures yelling 'Russia!', a MAGA-hatted man shouting 'Freedom!', a skeleton-filled 'Clinton Closet', a ladder labeled 'Soros', and Uncle Sam climbing at center. A red rectangle (added by the poster) highlights a hangman's noose labeled 'ANON' hanging in the middle of the scene.
text: Ben Garrison. @grrrgraphics.com. Apologies to MC Escher. A HOUSE DIVIDED... ME TOO! NEVER TRUMP! OPEN BORDERS! PROTECT BORDERS! SOROS. LIBERTY. MSM. FREEDOM! OUR REPUBLIC! ANON. RUSSIA! RUSSIA! RUSSIA! FREE STUFF! SOCIAL MEDIA. FREE SPEECH. OUR DEMOCRACY! WAR. TRUMP. NAZI! SJW SAFE SPACE. CLINTON CLOSET.
flags: Red box around the ANON noose appears added by whoever shared the image, not part of the original cartoon
